decision_rule.parallax_stage_justified: If a material population remains >2 arcsec after both affine and local-field correction while the same-Gaia cross-validation is good, a prospectively frozen physical-parallax stage is justified for that residual population.
decision_rule.systematic_supported: If a large majority of evaluable DIFFERENT_GAIA <=5 targets collapse to <=1-2 arcsec under a model whose held-out SAME_GAIA validation residuals are comparably small, treat the concentrated residual as primarily astrometric/crossmatch systematic.

fixed_models.coordinate_system: gnomonic tangent-plane coordinates centred deterministically on the two selected solution polygons

cross_validation.method: deterministic five-fold reference-star validation using SHA256(source_id_a|source_id_b) mod 5
cross_validation.purpose: measure whether the empirical astrometric model predicts held-out ordinary SAME_GAIA stars

global_affine.application: diagnostic residual only; no coordinate products are rewritten
global_affine.fit: iterative least squares with fixed 4-sigma clipping for at most 5 iterations
global_affine.form: six-parameter affine mapping from A tangent coordinates to B tangent coordinates

local_translation.estimate: component-wise median of B-A reference offsets
local_translation.selection: 25 nearest retained SAME_GAIA reference positions on the A side in tangent-plane distance

fixed_target_diagnostics.concentration: report target residual survival by anonymized opportunity-rank bands; no individual opportunity identifiers

input_population.reference_pairs: mutual-nearest SAME_GAIA pairs in the same opportunity with observed separation <=5 arcsec and both APPLAUSE-to-Gaia match distances <=1 arcsec
input_population.source_cache: exact 1,386 strict-HQ v094i scan/solution caches frozen by v094j and reused by v094k
input_population.target_pairs: mutual-nearest DIFFERENT_GAIA pairs with observed cross-site separation <=5 arcsec

known_at_freeze.interpretive_boundary: Strong opportunity/plate-pair concentration with negligible exact source-pair reuse is consistent with a field-level plate/solution/crossmatch mechanism. The rigid-translation diagnostic alone is insufficient to test spatially varying residuals.

purpose: Determine whether the concentrated DIFFERENT_GAIA <=5 arcsec residual from v094k is explained by plate/solution-specific spatial astrometric distortion beyond a rigid translation, before any physical-parallax interpretation, source-quality threshold relaxation, candidate inspection, controls, pixels, or registration.
stop_rule: Interpret v094l before any physical parallax pairing, threshold relaxation, or individual candidate inspection.
